# freejsonformatter.app

## Summary
freejsonformatter.app is a free, browser-based JSON formatter, validator, and minifier. It works entirely client-side with no login, no cloud processing, and no tracking.

## Key Facts
- 100% free, no account required
- All processing happens in the browser — no data sent to servers
- No analytics, no cookies, no tracking
- Works offline after first visit (service worker cached)
- Single HTML file, no frameworks, no build step

## Features
- Format/prettify JSON with customizable indentation (2 spaces, 4 spaces, tab)
- Minify JSON (remove all whitespace)
- Validate with precise error messages (line and column)
- Syntax highlighting (keys, strings, numbers, booleans, null)
- Interactive collapsible tree view with JSONPath display
- Auto-fix common issues (trailing commas, single quotes, unquoted keys, comments)
- Side-by-side compare/diff of two JSON objects
- Search within JSON (Ctrl+F)
- Drag-and-drop file import
- URL import (fetch JSON from endpoints)
- Copy and download formatted output
- Dark mode (persisted)
- Mobile responsive
